mapping.geometry: telescope sphere radius 15 m at origin; track from 3000 m above observation level to impact (0,0), vertical
mapping.index: constant index replaced by sim_telarray profile: fake-muon -A 0 only uses the profile; obdeect gets the same n(h) through --index-profile (index.txt from fake-muon printout)
mapping.photons: fake-muon -b 1 (single photons); obdeect muon-track emits single photons
mapping.positions: IACT x, y are the observation-plane crossing (z=0) of each ray; native rays crossed at z=0 (compared in obs_plane_xy_radius_native_vs_reference)
mapping.time_origin: emission time -h/c (track time zero at impact, beta=1); arrival at z=0 for both codes
mapping.time_convention: native: propagate --profile atmprof1.dat (air delay and refraction) and read t; reference: IACT time (raybnd: air delay included) + event time_offset; expected: t_em + (h + int_0^h (n-1) dh)/(|cz| c), straight path, n(h) from index.txt
mapping.time_reference_finding: sim_telarray IACT time is 0.005 ns above the straight-path expectation on average and differs at KS 0.02 (see time_reference_vs_analytic_*); obdeect matches the expectation (time_native_vs_analytic_*). Not judged: the reference residual is recorded only.
mapping.time_earlier_failure: the harness propagated without a profile (no air delay, 0.26 ns mean) and compared the sphere-centre plane; both were harness errors, not obdeect errors
mapping.sim_telarray: propagate --no-extinction --profile atmprof1.dat then obdeect stream to-simtel; both with the same chain settings, telescope_theta=0, trigger_telescopes=1

physics_limits.cherenkov_cos: max(1e-6, 5 se): float32 directions and 5e-8 index table precision
physics_limits.camera: max(0.01, 5 se) on the relative p.e. per event ratio (task rule)

limit_setting: Set before the first run: yield, Cherenkov angle, wavelength, azimuth, camera ratio. Set after exploratory runs: the cz check (KS replaced by a mean check, cz is float32 at 6e-8 resolution against a 2e-5 spread) and the position convention (observation plane). Time: judged against the analytic arrival; the sim_telarray-vs-analytic residual is recorded, not limited.
analytic: numerical integral of dN/ds x (fraction of Cherenkov azimuths hitting the sphere) over the track
reproducibility: fake-muon has no seed option: the reference sample changes between runs at the 1e-4 level in yield; the native run is seeded (17)
